units.leftText: Peter, an apostle of Jesus Christ, to the chosen ones who are living as foreigners in the Dispersion in Pontus, Galatia, Cappadocia, Asia, and Bithynia,
units.rightText: Peter, an apostle of Jesus Christ, to the elect who are sojourners of the Dispersion in Pontus, Galatia, Cappadocia, Asia, and Bithynia,

units.leftText: according to the foreknowledge of God the Father, in sanctification of the Spirit, that you may obey Jesus Christ and be sprinkled with his blood: Grace to you and peace be multiplied.
units.rightText: according to the foreknowledge of God the Father, in sanctification of the Spirit, unto obedience and sprinkling of the blood of Jesus Christ: Grace to you and peace be multiplied.

units.leftText: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who according to his great mercy caused us to be born again to a living hope through the resurrection of Jesus Christ from the dead,
units.rightText: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who according to his great mercy begat us again unto a living hope by the resurrection of Jesus Christ from the dead,

units.leftText: to an incorruptible and undefiled inheritance that doesn’t fade away, reserved in Heaven for you,
units.rightText: unto an inheritance incorruptible, and undefiled, and that fadeth not away, reserved in heaven for you,

units.leftText: who by the power of God are guarded through faith for a salvation ready to be revealed in the last time.
units.rightText: who by the power of God are guarded through faith unto a salvation ready to be revealed in the last time.

units.leftText: In this you greatly rejoice, though now for a little while, if need be, you have been grieved in various trials,
units.rightText: Wherein ye greatly rejoice, though now for a little while, if need be, ye have been put to grief in manifold trials,

units.leftText: that the proof of your faith, which is more precious than gold that perishes, even though it is tested by fire, may be found to result in praise, glory, and honor at the revelation of Jesus Christ—
units.rightText: that the proof of your faith, being more precious than gold that perisheth though it is proved by fire, may be found unto praise and glory and honor at the revelation of Jesus Christ:

units.leftText: whom, not having known, you love. In him, though now you don’t see him, yet believing, you rejoice greatly with joy that is unspeakable and full of glory,
units.rightText: whom not having seen ye love; on whom, though now ye see him not, yet believing, ye rejoice greatly with joy unspeakable and full of glory:

units.leftText: receiving the result of your faith, the salvation of your souls.
units.rightText: receiving the end of your faith, even the salvation of your souls.

units.leftText: Concerning this salvation, the prophets sought and searched diligently. They prophesied of the grace that would come to you,
units.rightText: Concerning which salvation the prophets sought and searched diligently, who prophesied of the grace that should come unto you:

units.leftText: searching for who or what kind of time the Spirit of Christ which was in them pointed to when he predicted the sufferings of Christ and the glories that would follow them.
units.rightText: searching what time or what manner of time the Spirit of Christ which was in them did point unto, when it testified beforehand the sufferings of Christ, and the glories that should follow them.

units.leftText: To them it was revealed that they served not themselves, but you, in these things, which now have been announced to you through those who preached the Good News to you by the Holy Spirit sent out from heaven; which things angels desire to look into.
units.rightText: To whom it was revealed, that not unto themselves, but unto you, did they minister these things, which now have been announced unto you through them that preached the gospel unto you by the Holy Spirit sent forth from heaven; which things angels desire to look into.

units.leftText: Therefore prepare your minds for action. Be sober, and set your hope fully on the grace that will be brought to you at the revelation of Jesus Christ—
units.rightText: Wherefore girding up the loins of your mind, be sober and set your hope perfectly on the grace that is to be brought unto you at the revelation of Jesus Christ;
leftNotes: 1:13 literally, “gird up the waist of your mind” or “put on the belt of the waist of your mind”

units.leftText: as children of obedience, not conforming yourselves according to your former lusts as in your ignorance,
units.rightText: as children of obedience, not fashioning yourselves according to your former lusts in the time of your ignorance:

units.leftText: but just as he who called you is holy, you yourselves also be holy in all of your behavior,
units.rightText: but like as he who called you is holy, be ye yourselves also holy in all manner of living;

units.leftText: because it is written, “You shall be holy, for I am holy.”
units.rightText: because it is written, Ye shall be holy; for I am holy.

units.leftText: If you call on him as Father, who without respect of persons judges according to each man’s work, pass the time of your living as foreigners here in reverent fear,
units.rightText: And if ye call on him as Father, who without respect of persons judgeth according to each man’s work, pass the time of your sojourning in fear:

units.leftText: knowing that you were redeemed, not with corruptible things like silver or gold, from the useless way of life handed down from your fathers,
units.rightText: knowing that ye were redeemed, not with corruptible things, with silver or gold, from your vain manner of life handed down from your fathers;

units.leftText: but with precious blood, as of a lamb without blemish or spot, the blood of Christ,
units.rightText: but with precious blood, as of a lamb without blemish and without spot, even the blood of Christ:

units.leftText: who was foreknown indeed before the foundation of the world, but was revealed in this last age for your sake,
units.rightText: who was foreknown indeed before the foundation of the world, but was manifested at the end of the times for your sake,

units.leftText: who through him are believers in God, who raised him from the dead and gave him glory, so that your faith and hope might be in God.
units.rightText: who through him are believers in God, that raised him from the dead, and gave him glory; so that your faith and hope might be in God.

units.leftText: Seeing you have purified your souls in your obedience to the truth through the Spirit in sincere brotherly affection, love one another from the heart fervently,
units.rightText: Seeing ye have purified your souls in your obedience to the truth unto unfeigned love of the brethren, love one another from the heart fervently:

units.leftText: having been born again, not of corruptible seed, but of incorruptible, through the word of God, which lives and remains forever.
units.rightText: having been begotten again, not of corruptible seed, but of incorruptible, through the word of God, which liveth and abideth.

units.leftText: For,
units.rightText: For,

units.leftText: but the Lord’s word endures forever.”
units.rightText: But the word of the Lord abideth for ever.

units.leftText: Putting away therefore all wickedness, all deceit, hypocrisies, envies, and all evil speaking,
units.rightText: Putting away therefore all wickedness, and all guile, and hypocrisies, and envies, and all evil speakings,

units.leftText: as newborn babies, long for the pure spiritual milk, that with it you may grow,
units.rightText: as newborn babes, long for the spiritual milk which is without guile, that ye may grow thereby unto salvation;

units.leftText: if indeed you have tasted that the Lord is gracious.
units.rightText: if ye have tasted that the Lord is gracious:

units.leftText: Come to him, a living stone, rejected indeed by men, but chosen by God, precious.
units.rightText: unto whom coming, a living stone, rejected indeed of men, but with God elect, precious,

units.leftText: You also as living stones are built up as a spiritual house, to be a holy priesthood, to offer up spiritual sacrifices, acceptable to God through Jesus Christ.
units.rightText: ye also, as living stones, are built up a spiritual house, to be a holy priesthood, to offer up spiritual sacrifices, acceptable to God through Jesus Christ.

units.leftText: Because it is contained in Scripture,
units.rightText: Because it is contained in scripture,

units.leftText: For you who believe therefore is the honor, but for those who are disobedient,
units.rightText: For you therefore that believe is the preciousness: but for such as disbelieve,

units.leftText: and,
units.rightText: and,

units.leftText: But you are a chosen race, a royal priesthood, a holy nation, a people for God’s own possession, that you may proclaim the excellence of him who called you out of darkness into his marvelous light.
units.rightText: But ye are an elect race, a royal priesthood, a holy nation, a people for God’s own possession, that ye may show forth the excellencies of him who called you out of darkness into his marvellous light:

units.leftText: In the past, you were not a people, but now are God’s people, who had not obtained mercy, but now have obtained mercy.
units.rightText: who in time past were no people, but now are the people of God: who had not obtained mercy, but now have obtained mercy.

units.leftText: Beloved, I beg you as foreigners and pilgrims to abstain from fleshly lusts which war against the soul,
units.rightText: Beloved, I beseech you as sojourners and pilgrims, to abstain from fleshly lusts, which war against the soul;

units.leftText: having good behavior among the nations, so in that of which they speak against you as evildoers, they may see your good works and glorify God in the day of visitation.
units.rightText: having your behavior seemly among the Gentiles; that, wherein they speak against you as evil-doers, they may by your good works, which they behold, glorify God in the day of visitation.

units.leftText: Therefore subject yourselves to every ordinance of man for the Lord’s sake: whether to the king, as supreme,
units.rightText: Be subject to every ordinance of man for the Lord’s sake: whether to the king, as supreme;

units.leftText: or to governors, as sent by him for vengeance on evildoers and for praise to those who do well.
units.rightText: or unto governors, as sent by him for vengeance on evil-doers and for praise to them that do well.

units.leftText: For this is the will of God, that by well-doing you should put to silence the ignorance of foolish men.
units.rightText: For so is the will of God, that by well-doing ye should put to silence the ignorance of foolish men:

units.leftText: Live as free people, yet not using your freedom for a cloak of wickedness, but as bondservants of God.
units.rightText: as free, and not using your freedom for a cloak of wickedness, but as bondservants of God.

units.leftText: Honor all men. Love the brotherhood. Fear God. Honor the king.
units.rightText: Honor all men. Love the brotherhood. Fear God. Honor the king.

units.leftText: Servants, be in subjection to your masters with all respect, not only to the good and gentle, but also to the wicked.
units.rightText: Servants, be in subjection to your masters with all fear; not only to the good and gentle, but also to the froward.

units.leftText: For it is commendable if someone endures pain, suffering unjustly, because of conscience toward God.
units.rightText: For this is acceptable, if for conscience toward God a man endureth griefs, suffering wrongfully.

units.leftText: For what glory is it if, when you sin, you patiently endure beating? But if when you do well, you patiently endure suffering, this is commendable with God.
units.rightText: For what glory is it, if, when ye sin, and are buffeted for it, ye shall take it patiently? but if, when ye do well, and suffer for it, ye shall take it patiently, this is acceptable with God.

units.leftText: For you were called to this, because Christ also suffered for us, leaving you an example, that you should follow his steps,
units.rightText: For hereunto were ye called: because Christ also suffered for you, leaving you an example, that ye should follow his steps:

units.leftText: who didn’t sin, “neither was deceit found in his mouth.”
units.rightText: who did no sin, neither was guile found in his mouth:

units.leftText: When he was cursed, he didn’t curse back. When he suffered, he didn’t threaten, but committed himself to him who judges righteously.
units.rightText: who, when he was reviled, reviled not again; when he suffered, threatened not; but committed himself to him that judgeth righteously:

units.leftText: He himself bore our sins in his body on the tree, that we, having died to sins, might live to righteousness. You were healed by his wounds.
units.rightText: who his own self bare our sins in his body upon the tree, that we, having died unto sins, might live unto righteousness; by whose stripes ye were healed.

units.leftText: For you were going astray like sheep; but now you have returned to the Shepherd and Overseer of your souls.
units.rightText: For ye were going astray like sheep; but are now returned unto the Shepherd and Bishop of your souls.
leftNotes: 2:25 “Overseer” is from the Greek ἐπίσκοπον, which can mean overseer, curator, guardian, or superintendent.

units.leftText: In the same way, wives, be in subjection to your own husbands, so that, even if any don’t obey the Word, they may be won by the behavior of their wives without a word,
units.rightText: In like manner, ye wives, be in subjection to your own husbands; that, even if any obey not the word, they may without the word be gained by the behavior of their wives;

units.leftText: seeing your pure behavior in fear.
units.rightText: beholding your chaste behavior coupled with fear.

units.leftText: Let your beauty come not from the outward adorning of braiding your hair, and of wearing gold ornaments or of putting on fine clothing,
units.rightText: Whose adorning let it not be the outward adorning of braiding the hair, and of wearing jewels of gold, or of putting on apparel;

units.leftText: but from the hidden person of the heart, in the incorruptible adornment of a gentle and quiet spirit, which is very precious in God’s sight.
units.rightText: but let it be the hidden man of the heart, in the incorruptible apparel of a meek and quiet spirit, which is in the sight of God of great price.

units.leftText: For this is how in the past the holy women who hoped in God also adorned themselves, being in subjection to their own husbands.
units.rightText: For after this manner aforetime the holy women also, who hoped in God, adorned themselves, being in subjection to their own husbands:

units.leftText: So Sarah obeyed Abraham, calling him lord, whose children you now are if you do well and are not put in fear by any terror.
units.rightText: as Sarah obeyed Abraham, calling him lord: whose children ye now are, if ye do well, and are not put in fear by any terror.

units.leftText: You husbands, in the same way, live with your wives according to knowledge, giving honor to the woman as to the weaker vessel, as also being joint heirs of the grace of life, that your prayers may not be hindered.
units.rightText: Ye husbands, in like manner, dwell with your wives according to knowledge, giving honor unto the woman, as unto the weaker vessel, as being also joint-heirs of the grace of life; to the end that your prayers be not hindered.

units.leftText: Finally, all of you be like-minded, compassionate, loving as brothers, tenderhearted, courteous,
units.rightText: Finally, be ye all likeminded, compassionate, loving as brethren, tenderhearted, humbleminded:

units.leftText: not rendering evil for evil or insult for insult; but instead blessing, knowing that you were called to this, that you may inherit a blessing.
units.rightText: not rendering evil for evil, or reviling for reviling; but contrariwise blessing; for hereunto were ye called, that ye should inherit a blessing.

units.leftText: For,
units.rightText: For,

units.leftText: Let him turn away from evil and do good.
units.rightText: And let him turn away from evil, and do good;

units.leftText: For the eyes of the Lord are on the righteous,
units.rightText: For the eyes of the Lord are upon the righteous,

units.leftText: Now who will harm you if you become imitators of that which is good?
units.rightText: And who is he that will harm you, if ye be zealous of that which is good?

units.leftText: But even if you should suffer for righteousness’ sake, you are blessed. “Don’t fear what they fear, neither be troubled.”
units.rightText: But even if ye should suffer for righteousness’ sake, blessed are ye: and fear not their fear, neither be troubled;

units.leftText: But sanctify the Lord God in your hearts. Always be ready to give an answer to everyone who asks you a reason concerning the hope that is in you, with humility and fear,
units.rightText: but sanctify in your hearts Christ as Lord: being ready always to give answer to every man that asketh you a reason concerning the hope that is in you, yet with meekness and fear:

units.leftText: having a good conscience. Thus, while you are spoken against as evildoers, they may be disappointed who curse your good way of life in Christ.
units.rightText: having a good conscience; that, wherein ye are spoken against, they may be put to shame who revile your good manner of life in Christ.

units.leftText: For it is better, if it is God’s will, that you suffer for doing what is right than for doing evil.
units.rightText: For it is better, if the will of God should so will, that ye suffer for well-doing than for evil-doing.

units.leftText: Because Christ also suffered for sins once, the righteous for the unrighteous, that he might bring you to God, being put to death in the flesh, but made alive in the Spirit,
units.rightText: Because Christ also suffered for sins once, the righteous for the unrighteous, that he might bring us to God; being put to death in the flesh, but made alive in the spirit;

units.leftText: in whom he also went and preached to the spirits in prison,
units.rightText: in which also he went and preached unto the spirits in prison,

units.leftText: who before were disobedient when God waited patiently in the days of Noah while the ship was being built. In it, few, that is, eight souls, were saved through water.
units.rightText: that aforetime were disobedient, when the longsuffering of God waited in the days of Noah, while the ark was a preparing, wherein few, that is, eight souls, were saved through water:

units.leftText: This is a symbol of baptism, which now saves you—not the putting away of the filth of the flesh, but the answer of a good conscience toward God—through the resurrection of Jesus Christ,
units.rightText: which also after a true likeness doth now save you, even baptism, not the putting away of the filth of the flesh, but the interrogation of a good conscience toward God, through the resurrection of Jesus Christ;

units.leftText: who is at the right hand of God, having gone into heaven, angels and authorities and powers being made subject to him.
units.rightText: who is on the right hand of God, having gone into heaven; angels and authorities and powers being made subject unto him.

units.leftText: Therefore, since Christ suffered for us in the flesh, arm yourselves also with the same mind; for he who has suffered in the flesh has ceased from sin,
units.rightText: Forasmuch then as Christ suffered in the flesh, arm ye yourselves also with the same mind; for he that hath suffered in the flesh hath ceased from sin;

units.leftText: that you no longer should live the rest of your time in the flesh for the lusts of men, but for the will of God.
units.rightText: that ye no longer should live the rest of your time in the flesh to the lusts of men, but to the will of God.

units.leftText: For we have spent enough of our past time doing the desire of the Gentiles, and having walked in lewdness, lusts, drunken binges, orgies, carousings, and abominable idolatries.
units.rightText: For the time past may suffice to have wrought the desire of the Gentiles, and to have walked in lasciviousness, lusts, winebibbings, revellings, carousings, and abominable idolatries:

units.leftText: They think it is strange that you don’t run with them into the same excess of riot, speaking evil of you.
units.rightText: wherein they think it strange that ye run not with them into the same excess of riot, speaking evil of you:

units.leftText: They will give account to him who is ready to judge the living and the dead.
units.rightText: who shall give account to him that is ready to judge the living and the dead.

units.leftText: For to this end the Good News was preached even to the dead, that they might be judged indeed as men in the flesh, but live as to God in the spirit.
units.rightText: For unto this end was the gospel preached even to the dead, that they might be judged indeed according to men in the flesh, but live according to God in the spirit.

units.leftText: But the end of all things is near. Therefore be of sound mind, self-controlled, and sober in prayer.
units.rightText: But the end of all things is at hand: be ye therefore of sound mind, and be sober unto prayer:

units.leftText: And above all things be earnest in your love among yourselves, for love covers a multitude of sins.
units.rightText: above all things being fervent in your love among yourselves; for love covereth a multitude of sins:

units.leftText: Be hospitable to one another without grumbling.
units.rightText: using hospitality one to another without murmuring:

units.leftText: As each has received a gift, employ it in serving one another, as good managers of the grace of God in its various forms.
units.rightText: according as each hath received a gift, ministering it among yourselves, as good stewards of the manifold grace of God;

units.leftText: If anyone speaks, let it be as it were the very words of God. If anyone serves, let it be as of the strength which God supplies, that in all things God may be glorified through Jesus Christ, to whom belong the glory and the dominion forever and ever. Amen.
units.rightText: if any man speaketh, speaking as it were oracles of God; if any man ministereth, ministering as of the strength which God supplieth: that in all things God may be glorified through Jesus Christ, whose is the glory and the dominion for ever and ever. Amen.

units.leftText: Beloved, don’t be astonished at the fiery trial which has come upon you to test you, as though a strange thing happened to you.
units.rightText: Beloved, think it not strange concerning the fiery trial among you, which cometh upon you to prove you, as though a strange thing happened unto you:

units.leftText: But because you are partakers of Christ’s sufferings, rejoice, that at the revelation of his glory you also may rejoice with exceeding joy.
units.rightText: but insomuch as ye are partakers of Christ’s sufferings, rejoice; that at the revelation of his glory also ye may rejoice with exceeding joy.

units.leftText: If you are insulted for the name of Christ, you are blessed, because the Spirit of glory and of God rests on you. On their part he is blasphemed, but on your part he is glorified.
units.rightText: If ye are reproached for the name of Christ, blessed are ye; because the Spirit of glory and the Spirit of God resteth upon you.

units.leftText: But let none of you suffer as a murderer, or a thief, or an evil doer, or a meddler in other men’s matters.
units.rightText: For let none of you suffer as a murderer, or a thief, or an evil-doer, or as a meddler in other men’s matters:

units.leftText: But if one of you suffers for being a Christian, let him not be ashamed; but let him glorify God in this matter.
units.rightText: but if a man suffer as a Christian, let him not be ashamed; but let him glorify God in this name.

units.leftText: For the time has come for judgment to begin with the household of God. If it begins first with us, what will happen to those who don’t obey the Good News of God?
units.rightText: For the time is come for judgment to begin at the house of God: and if it begin first at us, what shall be the end of them that obey not the gospel of God?

units.leftText: “If it is hard for the righteous to be saved, what will happen to the ungodly and the sinner?”
units.rightText: And if the righteous is scarcely saved, where shall the ungodly and sinner appear?

units.leftText: Therefore let them also who suffer according to the will of God in doing good entrust their souls to him, as to a faithful Creator.
units.rightText: Wherefore let them also that suffer according to the will of God commit their souls in well-doing unto a faithful Creator.

units.leftText: Therefore I exhort the elders among you, as a fellow elder and a witness of the sufferings of Christ, and who will also share in the glory that will be revealed:
units.rightText: The elders therefore among you I exhort, who am a fellow-elder, and a witness of the sufferings of Christ, who am also a partaker of the glory that shall be revealed:

units.leftText: shepherd the flock of God which is among you, exercising the oversight, not under compulsion, but voluntarily; not for dishonest gain, but willingly;
units.rightText: Tend the flock of God which is among you, exercising the oversight, not of constraint, but willingly, according to the will of God; nor yet for filthy lucre, but of a ready mind;

units.leftText: not as lording it over those entrusted to you, but making yourselves examples to the flock.
units.rightText: neither as lording it over the charge allotted to you, but making yourselves ensamples to the flock.

units.leftText: When the chief Shepherd is revealed, you will receive the crown of glory that doesn’t fade away.
units.rightText: And when the chief Shepherd shall be manifested, ye shall receive the crown of glory that fadeth not away.

units.leftText: Likewise, you younger ones, be subject to the elder. Yes, all of you clothe yourselves with humility and subject yourselves to one another; for “God resists the proud, but gives grace to the humble.”
units.rightText: Likewise, ye younger, be subject unto the elder. Yea, all of you gird yourselves with humility, to serve one another: for God resisteth the proud, but giveth grace to the humble.

units.leftText: Humble yourselves therefore under the mighty hand of God, that he may exalt you in due time,
units.rightText: Humble yourselves therefore under the mighty hand of God, that he may exalt you in due time;

units.leftText: casting all your worries on him, because he cares for you.
units.rightText: casting all your anxiety upon him, because he careth for you.

units.leftText: Be sober and self-controlled. Be watchful. Your adversary, the devil, walks around like a roaring lion, seeking whom he may devour.
units.rightText: Be sober, be watchful: your adversary the devil, as a roaring lion, walketh about, seeking whom he may devour:

units.leftText: Withstand him steadfast in your faith, knowing that your brothers who are in the world are undergoing the same sufferings.
units.rightText: whom withstand stedfast in your faith, knowing that the same sufferings are accomplished in your brethren who are in the world.

units.leftText: But may the God of all grace, who called you to his eternal glory by Christ Jesus, after you have suffered a little while, perfect, establish, strengthen, and settle you.
units.rightText: And the God of all grace, who called you unto his eternal glory in Christ, after that ye have suffered a little while, shall himself perfect, establish, strengthen you.

units.leftText: To him be the glory and the power forever and ever. Amen.
units.rightText: To him be the dominion for ever and ever. Amen.

units.leftText: Through Silvanus, our faithful brother, as I consider him, I have written to you briefly, exhorting and testifying that this is the true grace of God in which you stand.
units.rightText: By Silvanus, our faithful brother, as I account him, I have written unto you briefly, exhorting, and testifying that this is the true grace of God: stand ye fast therein.

units.leftText: She who is in Babylon, chosen together with you, greets you. So does Mark, my son.
units.rightText: She that is in Babylon, elect together with you, saluteth you; and so doth Mark my son.

units.leftText: Greet one another with a kiss of love.
units.rightText: Salute one another with a kiss of love.
